notes.title: Hook Line & Sniper Official Soundtrack is now on STEAM!!
notes.notes:
[h2]The complete Official Soundtrack for Hook Line & Sniper is now available on steam!
[/h2]

Hopefully you all enjoyed Hook Line & Sniper's BGM? If so, you can now own a copy of it :)
Grab all 6 tracks featured in-game, including a bonus track composed by game composer ForteXP!


The soundtrack can be purchased standalone for $1.99.

Also, to celebrate its release, we're bundling it with the full game! So if you haven't grabbed a copy yet, or would like to gift one to a friend, now's a great time!


Thank you all for keeping up with our project this far! We really do appreciate it :)
More from us to come in the future!


Special Thanks for ForteXP for providing the bonus track! You can check out their other video game music on their YouTube Channel, [url=https://www.youtube.com/@forteXP]forteXP[/url]

notes.title: Minor Patch Notes 3
notes.notes:
We've added a quick retry button to the pause menu! For those who wanted to restart a level without wasting even a second, you'll appreciate this. In addition, a few more little bugs have been fixed. This might be the last small patch? Who knows.
Full change log:
[list]
[*] Added quick retry, as mentioned above.
[*] Fixed a minor audio bug introduced from an earlier patch.
[*] Gave the stun progress bar a black border for higher contrast.
[*] Fixed a bug where the enemy spawner's internal timer was slightly inaccurate. It's unlikely anyone will notice this, but it was bothering me that the math wasn't right.
[*] Fixed some bugs with the friends-only leaderboard. Friends' global positions are replaced with positions among friends, and the scroll down button won't let you scroll past all the entries.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch Notes 2
notes.notes:
Fixed some more minor bugs here and there. All the info and feedback we've gotten already has been great! There may be a few more of these small patches as more things come up. We'll see.

[list]
[*]Removed a challenge players found to be too frustrating.
[*]Fixed a bug where some people wouldn't get the krill count achievements.
[/list]
Some bug fixes regarding the final boss:
[list]
[*][spoiler]Patched a potential exploit for getting higher scores on blunderpuss.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Fixed an issue where blunderpuss scores were much higher than they should be on low difficulties.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Fixed a bug where the aiming animation of blunderpuss's sniper would jump around unpredictably.[/spoiler]
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Just fixing a few small bugs and issues we've found. Nothing major.

[list]
[*] Some stars were found to be much more difficult than we intended. These have been adjusted.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mid-game challenge descriptions showed the wrong numbers for certain score objectives.
[*] Fixed a bug where, after fighting the final boss, the style letter would shake aggressively for a while.
[*] Fixed a minor bug in the challenge list in the pause menu (sometimes wouldn't show a world you've played).
[*] Fixed a bug where a challenge could have the wrong description in certain edge cases.
[*] (weapon spoiler)  [spoiler] Fixed a bug where the minigun ammo would stay on cooldown between games. [/spoiler]
[/list]
